calls.video_title: Dan Ferris: Copper Could Double—and He Says You Have to Own It | SIH
calls.thesis: Recommended last December, up ~120%+: "I'm not selling"; buying here is "not a terrible idea" with lower expectations. Crack spreads near records; refiners now ~1x replacement cost.
calls.bull: Crack spreads stay elevated; stocks could remain elevated for some time.
calls.bear: Not nearly the bet it was 10 months ago; cyclical run-up could retreat.
